name: zhida-codex
description: Find actual Zhida support problems and maintain concise, accurate knowledge and keyword replies.

interface.shortDescription: Find support issues and keep answers concise.
interface.longDescription: Find customer questions and replies by text or date, inspect the evidence behind an answer, and update the relevant knowledge or keyword rule. Keep answers concise while preserving essential conditions. Report saved content and indexing status, resume interrupted changes, and protect later edits during rollback. Permanent deletion requires a separate confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Check recent support replies and explain what needs fixing.
Find the conversation about a locked account and inspect why it was answered this way.
Shorten this knowledge answer while preserving the necessary conditions and steps.
Narrow this keyword rule so it only matches the intended question.
Update the refund answer to this new policy.
Find this obsolete entry and prepare it for permanent deletion.
